description: Get albums saved in the user's library. Set fetch_all=true to retrieve the entire collection. Output is capped by max_results (default: SPOTIFY_MCP_MAX_ITEMS).

fetch_all.description: Fetch all pages instead of one page (ignores limit/offset)

max_results.description: Max items to return (default: SPOTIFY_MCP_MAX_ITEMS env or 50)

response_format.description: 'concise' = human prose, 'detailed' = more fields in prose, 'json' = raw API object

name: get_saved_albums
